Atlantis NDT Lead Nurture 2028 — 7-Touch Engagement Designed for Long-Cycle Enterprise Buyers

Atlantis NDT primary buyers are inspection-engineering managers + asset-integrity leads + reliability-engineering directors + procurement leads at refining + petrochem + marine + aerospace + power + LNG + mining + hydrogen + CCS operators. Decision cycles run 3-12 months. Atlantis NDT respects this by replacing high-pressure salesy follow-up with a structured 7-touch educational sequence — case studies, ROI calculators, peer references, webinars, free consultation reminders. Every touch delivers a useful artefact; no touch repeats the same pitch.

Touch 1 — Confirmation + Initial Resource Pack (Day 0)

Immediately after Atlantis NDT enquiry submission, prospect receives a confirmation email + tailored resource pack — relevant case study PDF for their vertical, link to the vertical-specific ROI calculator, schedule-link to book the free 30-min consultation, founder LinkedIn introduction. No sales pitch.

Touch 2 — Founder LinkedIn Connection + Personal Note (Day 1-2)

Atlantis NDT founder Anoop Rayavarapu (ASNT NDT Level III) sends a personal LinkedIn connection request with a 2-sentence note referencing prospect's specific enquiry context. Personal, not templated. Many enterprise buyers respond more readily to LinkedIn than email — Atlantis NDT meets buyers where they are.

Touch 3 — Vertical Deep-Dive Article (Day 5-7)

Email delivers an in-depth article specific to prospect's named vertical — refining ROI deep-dive, marine IACS report-format guide, aerospace NAS 410 cert pathway analysis, LNG cross-region delivery model, etc. Articles run 1,500-3,000 words with code crosswalks + Atlantis NDT delivery anchor + free consultation CTA.

Touch 4 — Peer Reference Call Invitation (Day 14-21)

Email invites prospect to schedule an anonymised peer-reference call — 30-min discussion with an existing Atlantis NDT customer at similar asset class + scale. Reference call format: customer describes pre-Atlantis pain, decision criteria, 12-month outcomes, what they'd do differently. Atlantis NDT does not attend the call — peer-to-peer only.

Touch 5 — Webinar Invitation (Day 21-28)

Monthly Atlantis NDT webinar invitation — topics rotate (Marine IACS report format, Digital Twin ROI for refining, RBI program design per API 581, AI for NDT defect detection acceptance pathway, LMS for in-house corporate training, etc.). Webinar runs 45 min — 30 min content, 15 min live Q&A with founder + Level III consultants.

Touch 6 — ROI Calculator Refresh + Free Demo (Day 35-42)

Email delivers updated ROI calculator output customised to prospect's named asset count + inspector roster size + region. Includes free-demo offer — 30-min live demo with prospect's actual asset class + workflow + integration stack walked through. ASNT NDT Level III + Atlantis founder co-presenter.

Touch 7 — Free Consultation Final Reminder + Custom Quote (Day 50-60)

Final touch — short email recap of all 6 prior touches + final free consultation reminder + indicative scope-of-work + tailored quote (region + scope + delivery model + team size — Atlantis publishes no public pricing per §18). Prospects who stay non-responsive after touch 7 are graduated to long-cycle reactivation (touched every 6 months with year-end industry report + new case studies).

Sequence Design Principles

Three principles: (1) every touch delivers a useful artefact regardless of response intent — never an empty "checking in"; (2) cadence stretches across 60+ days to match enterprise decision-cycle, not 7-day high-pressure sequences; (3) ASNT NDT Level III founder is the primary voice on every touch — not generic marketing automation. Atlantis NDT respects every prospect's inbox. Submit a new enquiry to trigger the sequence.
